defs.def: a performer, politician, sports player, etc., who is popular where they were born 故乡的骄子（可指演员、政治家、运动员等）

ex.s: They offered the dog some of her favorite peanut butter treats.
ex.t: 他们甚至让她坐在沙发上，但这个老家伙再也不是她平时那个快乐的自己了。

ex.s: Do you want to be a better athlete in your favorite sport?
ex.t: 你想在你最喜欢的运动中成为更优秀的运动员吗？

defs.def: (in the US) a candidate for president who is supported by his or her own state in the first part of a campaign （美国大选第一阶段）本州支持的总统候选人

ex.s: It was his favorite work.
ex.t: 这是他最喜欢的作品。

defs.def: a person or thing that you like more than the others of the same type 特别喜爱的人（或事物）

ex.s: All that week, Poppy didn’t seem interested in her dinner, her favorite toy, or even in her daily walk.
ex.t: 那一整周，波比似乎对她的晚餐、最爱的玩具，甚至每日的散步都不感兴趣。

ex.s: “But that’s why this is one of my favorite books.”
ex.t: “但这正是它成为我最喜欢的书之一的原因。”

ex.s: In your free time, you can explore the city, have language classes, surf or choose your favourite from among the following.
ex.t: 在空闲时间，你可以探索城市、上语言课、冲浪，或从以下选项中挑选你最喜欢的。

ex.s: Which is Mr Green's favorite movie?
ex.t: 格林先生最喜欢的电影是哪部？

ex.s: A 35-minute hand-clapping, foot-stomping musical version of a Mark Twain favorite returns with this Tall Stacks festival.
ex.t: 一部35分钟、令人拍手顿足的音乐版马克·吐温名作，随Tall Stacks艺术节回归。

ex.s: In secondary school, art was my favourite subject.
ex.t: 在中学里，美术是我最喜欢的科目。

ex.s: Put off watching your favorite show until the weekend or wait 10 extra minutes before going for that cake.
ex.t: 将您最喜爱的节目推迟到周末观看，或额外等待10分钟后再去吃蛋糕。

ex.s: And my favorite: Safe.
ex.t: 而我最喜欢的词：Safe。

ex.s: I didn't think about it much until a morning last week when I knocked my favorite teapot off the table.
ex.t: 我没太在意这件事，直到上周一个早晨，我把最心爱的茶壶从桌上碰掉了。

ex.s: Pudding was his favorite dessert.
ex.t: 布丁是他最爱的甜点。

ex.s: England’s all-time favourite sport.
ex.t: 英格兰一直以来最喜爱的运动。

ex.s: Of all the stories of my early childhood, the one about a  36  is my mother’s favorite.
ex.t: 在我幼年的所有故事里，那个关于___36___的故事是母亲最爱的。

ex.s: My Favourite Books
ex.t: 我最喜欢的书

ex.s: “I didn’t like the ending,” I said to my favorite college professor.
ex.t: "我不喜欢这个结局，"我对我最喜欢的大学教授说。

ex.s: Here are some of our favourites, to remind us that some of the English we learn in the classroom is rather different from the English in the outside world!
ex.t: 以下是我们最喜欢的几个例子，它们提醒我们，我们在课堂上学的一些英语和外面世界里的英语相当不一样！

ex.s: My favorite place to take photos is Yellowstone National Park.
ex.t: 我最喜欢拍照的地方是黄石国家公园。

ex.s: B: My favourite food is...
ex.t: 我最喜欢的食物是……

ex.s: A: What's your favourite TV programme?
ex.t: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？

ex.s: B: My favourite TV programme is...
ex.t: 我最喜欢的电视节目是……

defs.def: a person who is liked better by sb and receives better treatment than others 受宠的人；得到偏爱的人
the horse, runner, team, etc. that is expected to win （比赛中）被认为最有希望的获胜者
the person who is expected by most people to get a particular job or position （取得职位等的）最有希望者
